parameters.query:
-- INSERT … ON CONFLICT: la fila puede no existir si la clínica se creó después
-- de correr el script 068.
INSERT INTO public.clinic_preferences (
    clinic_id, discounts_enabled, discount_scope, default_discount_pct, max_discount_pct
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM public.clinic WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE ORDER BY id LIMIT 1),
       $1, $2, $3, $4
ON CONFLICT (clinic_id) DO UPDATE
    SET discounts_enabled    = EXCLUDED.discounts_enabled,
        discount_scope       = EXCLUDED.discount_scope,
        default_discount_pct = EXCLUDED.default_discount_pct,
        max_discount_pct     = EXCLUDED.max_discount_pct
RETURNING id,
          discounts_enabled,
          discount_scope,
          default_discount_pct,
          max_discount_pct

meta.notes:
CONFIGURACIÓN REQUERIDA:
1. Crear/seleccionar la credencial 'Postgres' en el nodo 'Guardar Preferencias' (reemplaza POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_ID).
2. Activar el workflow.

RUTA DEL WEBHOOK:
POST https://<tu-n8n>/webhook/clinic/preferences/upsert

CUERPO:
{
  "discounts_enabled": true,
  "discount_scope": "line",
  "default_discount_pct": 10,
  "max_discount_pct": 30
}

RESPUESTA: los mismos campos ya normalizados, más "success": true.

TABLA REQUERIDA: clinic_preferences (ver database/scripts/068_20260814_clinic-preferences-and-discounts.sql)
